headline: Pakistan Regulator Slashes Petrol and High-Speed Diesel Prices
summary: The Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority notified a price cut for petroleum products, lowering petrol to 318 rupees per litre and high-speed diesel to 353 rupees per litre for late November.
why: Regulated fuel price adjustments influence domestic transport costs and retail inflation metrics in emerging economies.

impacts.name: Pakistan
impacts.why: Fuel prices were reduced nationwide by the regulatory authority.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
